title: Object page empty / 'Failed to drill-down': single-row read returns several rows
symptom: GET <Entity>(<key>) answers 'Multiple instances returned for entity <X> using given key'; browser console shows 'Failed to drill-down'. The object page may seem to work only because FE reuses the list cache.
rootCause: A query implementation (custom entity / query provider class) ignores the key filters of a single-row read and returns the whole result set.

solutions.label: Honour the key filter in the query provider
solutions.body: When the key fields arrive as filter, return exactly the matching row. Keys must be stable: a running number (STT) that changes when other filters change is not a key.

prevention: Test the object page with a filter that changes the list (so FE cannot use its cache).
